verdict_msg: HF: Skunkworks-JL analytical prediction FAILS even at low-cluster + moderate-corruption counterfactual regime. HP1: COSINE at cluster_cos=0.30 corrupt=0.50 r@1=1.0000 > 0.9 (baseline STILL saturates in the JL-friendly counterfactual). HP3: r@1=1.0000 at (0.90, 0.75) reproduces regression. Interpretation: analytical model has DEEPER LIMITATION than just cluster-cos-0.90; bit/value exact-carrier dominates at ALL corruption > 50% regardless of cluster_cos. JL orthogonality atom's declared scope is NOT scope-refinable via cluster_cos axis at 75% corruption regime. Suggests route to research 2x-drill on exact-carrier-vs-JL mechanism at moderate corruption or lower N_PAIRS/tighter cluster geometry. COSINE grid: c=0.30,r=0.50:1.0000 | c=0.30,r=0.75:1.0000 ;; c=0.50,r=0.50:1.0000 | c=0.50,r=0.75:1.0000 ;; c=0.70,r=0.50:1.0000 | c=0.70,r=0.75:1.0000 ;; c=0.90,r=0.50:1.0000 | c=0.90,r=0.75:1.0000. HIPPO grid: c=0.30,r=0.50:1.0000 | c=0.30,r=0.75:1.0000 ;; c=0.50,r=0.50:1.0000 | c=0.50,r=0.75:0.9973 ;; c=0.70,r=0.50:0.9993 | c=0.70,r=0.75:0.9460 ;; c=0.90,r=0.50:0.7573 | c=0.90,r=0.75:0.5127. Boundary_r0.75=(0.30,ALL_SATURATE). Boundary_r0.50=(0.30,ALL_SATURATE).
